Jharkhand : Nisha Bhagat mamle men purv CM Arjun Munda ne rajy sarkar par lagae ganbhir aarop
About The Company:
Varsh 1984 men sthapit nyutral pablishing haus limited bharat ke shirsh midiya evan sanchar samuhon men ek hai. yah jharkhand, bihar aur pashchim bangal men sakriy hai. iske phlaigship brand ka nam hai prabhat khabar. kanpni mobail aur ganvon ke lie nikalne vale saptahik samachar patr ke jariye ivent evan aautdor, intarnet, vailyu aided sarvisej bhi deti hai.
